name.ja: HG 1/144 ゴーストガンダム

description.ja: 紫 炎 の 「 幽 霊 （ ゴ ー ス ト ） 」、 飛 来
description.en: A “ghost” of purple flame flies

description.ja: 幽霊 ふたたび ―
description.en: Ghost again -

description.ja: 『機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム ゴースト』より、ゴーストガンダムが1/144スケールでHGシリーズに登場！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam Ghost", Ghost Gundam appears in the HG series in 1/144 scale!

description.ja: 本体シルバー部分は艶消しメッキを採用。
description.en: The main body silver part uses matte plating.

description.ja: 輝きのある美しいシルバーを再現。
description.en: Reproduces a beautiful shiny silver.

description.ja: 全身を覆う印象的な「ファントムライト」発動状態を再現できるエフェクトパーツが付属するほか、武装や変形機構を有する圧倒的ボリュームで商品化！
description.en: In addition to coming with effect parts that can reproduce the state in which the impressive "Phantom Light" that covers the entire body is activated, it is commercialized in overwhelming volume with weapons and transformation mechanisms!

description.ja: ●　機体フォルム、カラーリングを一部新規造形で再現。
description.en: ● The aircraft form and coloring are partially reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ゴーストガンダムの機体形状を洗練された抜群のプロポーションで立体化。
description.en: The Ghost Gundam's body shape is three-dimensionalized with sophisticated and outstanding proportions.

description.ja: 特徴的なカラーリングはパーツごとに分割し、メッキパーツと成形色で色分けを実現。
description.en: The distinctive coloring is divided into parts, and the plated parts and molding colors are color-coded.

description.ja: 頭部や胸部レリーフをはじめ、腕部や脚部など各所細部のディテールをモールドとパーツ分割で再現。
description.en: Various details such as the head and chest relief, arms and legs are reproduced using molds and separate parts.

description.ja: シルバー、レッド、ホワイトのカラーリングは劇中イメージに忠実に再現。
description.en: The silver, red, and white coloring is faithfully reproduced from the image in the play.

description.ja: ●　アクション性を追求した可動域を実現
description.en: ● Achieves a range of motion that pursues action.

description.ja: ゴーストガンダムのアクションイメージを最大限引き出すための可動構造を搭載。
description.en: Equipped with a movable structure to maximize Ghost Gundam's action image.

description.ja: 自由度の高いダイナミックなポージングが可能。
description.en: Dynamic poses with a high degree of freedom are possible.

description.ja: 多目的攻撃兵装「クジャク」も付属。
description.en: A multi-purpose attack weapon "Peacock" is also included.

description.ja: 腕部/脚部
description.en: arms/legs

description.ja: 二の腕、脚部はファントムガンダムとは異なった形状も一部ランナー流用にて再現。
description.en: The upper arms and legs have a different shape from the Phantom Gundam, but some of them are reproduced by using Runner.

description.ja: 背部
description.en: back

description.ja: 背部ウイングは上下、左右へ展開できる多軸構造。
description.en: The back wing has a multi-axis structure that can be deployed vertically and horizontally.

description.ja: また本機に搭載された強制冷却カートリッジを新規造形にて完全再現。
description.en: In addition, the forced cooling cartridge installed in this machine is completely reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: 腰部/フレイム・ライフル
description.en: Waist/Flame Rifle

description.ja: 腰部に装備されたフレイム・ライフルを新規造形で立体化。
description.en: The flame rifle equipped on the waist is three-dimensionalized with new modeling.

description.ja: 持ち手差し替えにより展開時と収納状態を再現。
description.en: Reproduce the unfolded and stored state by replacing the handle.

description.ja: ●　溢れ出す「ファントムライト」　ゴースト仕様の紫エフェクトパーツが付属
description.en: ● Overflowing "phantom light" comes with ghost-specific purple effect parts

description.ja: 全身から溢れ出す「ファントムライト」発動状態をパーツの差し替えで再現できるクリアエフェクトパーツが付属。
description.en: Comes with clear effect parts that can be used to recreate the state in which the "phantom light" overflowing from the entire body is activated by replacing parts.

description.ja: 炎のようなゆらめきをモールド、表面形状、ゆらぎ形状で全身細部まで演出。
description.en: The mold, surface shape, and fluctuating shape create a flame-like shimmer throughout the entire body.

description.ja: 頭部パーツは3種の内2種の選択式。
description.en: Head parts can be selected from two out of three types.

description.ja: 「強制放熱モード」「片目ダメージ状態」を差し替えで演出可能。
description.en: "Forced heat dissipation mode " and " one eye damage state" can be produced by replacing them.

description.ja: 特徴的なフェイスマスクはモールド豊かに表現。
description.en: The characteristic face mask is expressed in a rich mold.

description.ja: フレイム・ソードを再現可能な２種類の斬撃エフェクトパーツも同梱。
description.en: Two types of slashing effect parts that can reproduce the flame sword are also included.

description.ja: 斬撃エフェクトの２種類を再現。
description.en: Reproduces two types of slashing effects.

description.ja: ●　蜃気楼鳥（ミラージュ・ワゾー）形態へ変形機構を搭載
description.en: ● Equipped with a mechanism to transform into a mirage bird (Mirage Wazo) form.

description.ja: 惑星間巡航形態「蜃気楼鳥」への変形が可能。差し替えパーツによる変形方式を採用し、
description.en: Can transform into interplanetary cruising form "Mirage Bird". Adopts a deformation method using replacement parts,

description.ja: 変形時のプロポーションを追求。ファントムライト発動状態も再現可能。
description.en: Pursuing proportions during transformation. Phantom light activation state can also be reproduced.

description.ja: 別売りのアクションベースと組み合わせて、蜃気楼鳥形態でディスプレイできる専用ジョイントも付属。
description.en: A special joint is also included that allows you to display it in mirage bird form by combining it with the action base (sold separately).

description.ja: ●　アクションベース（別売り）と組み合わせて、ＨＧ 1/144 クロスボーン・ガンダムＸ－０フルクロス（別売り）とのディスプレイが可能！
description.en: ● In combination with the action base (sold separately), you can display HG 1/144 Crossbone Gundam X-0 Full Cross (sold separately)!

description.ja: 付属武装：
description.en: Attached weapons:

description.ja: 多目的攻撃兵装「クジャク」／フレイム・ライフル／フレイム・ソード
description.en: Multi-purpose attack weapon "Peacock"/Flame Rifle/Flame Sword

description.en: Complete set of effect parts for Phantom Light / Effect parts for Flame Sword / Face parts
